facts.label: In short

meta.title: GnomeVPN — a fast Hysteria2 VPN
meta.description: A no-logs VPN on its own servers: Hysteria2, VLESS + Reality and WireGuard. Servers in several countries, one link for every device, the first day free.

connect.title: Connected in three minutes
connect.intro: Pick your device and we'll show what to press. No settings, no config files.
connect.wireguard: Need a plain WireGuard config? That's in your account too.

pricing.title: One plan, three terms
pricing.intro: Every term includes everything: all servers, all protocols, {count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}. The longer the term, the cheaper the month.
pricing.trial: First comes a free day, no card.
pricing.renew: The subscription renews itself while auto-renewal is on. One button in your account turns it off; access stays until the end of the paid term.

inside.title: Where the servers are, and what's inside
inside.intro: Our own nodes in two countries. Switch between them in the app at no extra cost.

protocol.title: Three protocols
protocol.body: Hysteria2 is fast and holds up on mobile networks. VLESS + Reality covers networks where UDP doesn't get through. WireGuard, if that's what you're used to.

noLogs.title: No logs
noLogs.body: We keep no connection history and none of the addresses you open. All that remains per device is when it was last active.

devices.title: {count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}, and more
devices.body: Phone and computer at once on one subscription. Need more? Add places in your account.

platforms.title: Every platform
platforms.body: iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, Android TV and Apple TV — one link for all of them.

openFormat.title: The link stays yours
openFormat.body: The subscription format is standard: paste it into Hiddify, Streisand or v2rayNG. You are locked into neither the app nor us.

note.title: A word from the gnome
note.why: We charge for a subscription because a free VPN has to earn from something else — ads, its users' data, or overloaded servers. We'd rather not.
note.cancel: Not for you? Turn renewal off in your account with one button. Access stays until the end of the paid term; no calls or emails needed.
note.refund: And within 14 days of paying we'll refund the unused part — just write to us.
